## Level-Up Flow

**1. When the UI offers it:**
After combat ends, `CombatComponent`/`game-console.component.ts` (`sendCombatAction` handler) reads `res.canLevelUp` from the combat response and calls `this.charSvc.setCanLevelUp(res.canLevelUp)`. This flips a signal in the character service. `character-sheet.component.html` watches `svc.canLevelUp()` and shows a "⬆ Level Up Available!" banner, exposing an ability-choice UI that triggers `levelUp(ability)` in `game-console.component.ts`.

**2. Endpoint called:**
`game-api.service.ts` → `levelUp()` posts to **`POST /api/levelup`** with `{ sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice }`. Handled by `worker/src/routes/levelup.ts`, which validates input, fetches the character, confirms `shouldLevelUp(character)` (XP ≥ `XP_THRESHOLDS[level]`, capped at level 10), then calls `levelUp()` in `worker/src/services/character.ts`.

**3. What changes on the character** (`levelUp()` in `services/character.ts`):
- `level` → `level + 1`
- `max_hp` → `max_hp + (roll(hitDie) + modifier(con))`, where `hitDie` comes from `CLASS_HIT_DICE` (e.g. Fighter 10, Wizard 6)
- `hp` → `min(hp + hpGain, newMaxHp)`
- Chosen ability score (`abilityChoice`, one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha) → `+2`

Changes persist via `updateCharacter()` (SQL UPDATE), an AI narrative is generated (`generateLevelUpNarrative`), logged to `adventure_log`, and pushed into the session history/response (`updatedCharacter`, `newLevel`).
